headlines.title: Trump Says US is ‘Only Semi-Negotiating’ With Iran
headlines.description: Oil prices jumped higher after Iran issued a long list of demands to reopen the Strait of Hormuz. The United States announced more sanctions against Iran as questions loom over negotiations. NBC’s Keir Simmons reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Search for survivors underway after 7.4-magnitude earthquake hits Colombia
headlines.description: A 7.4-magnitude earthquake rattled western Colombia, causing buildings to collapse and setting off a search for survivors. NBC News’ George Solis reports on the developing situation and an early assessment of the damage.

headlines.title: Woman and Baby Die After Boat Capsized in New York Harbor
headlines.description: New York City police are on the scene of a tragic boating accident where a woman and a young child were killed near the Statue of Liberty. The NYPD says they got a call about an overturned boat and when crews arrived, they found 12 people had already been rescued from the water but a 27-year-old woman and five-month-old little girl did not survive. WNBC’s Jessica Cunnington reports for Sunday TODAY.

headlines.title: Make the Most of Every Inch of Space With These Products
headlines.description: Small spaces can get cluttered easily, so Shop TODAY fashion and lifestyle contributor Chassie Post breaks down her favorite products to maximize your storage. See her recommendations, which include under bed storage with wheels, a bathroom tool organizer, and more!

headlines.title: Flock cameras vandalized across the country as the debate around them continues
headlines.description: Communities across the country are debating whether or not they should keep using controversial Flock Safety cameras as a number of them are vandalized. Police say the cameras help them track down criminals, but critics say they’re an invasion of privacy. NBC News’ Dana Griffin reports.

headlines.title: Teenage boys are obsessing over luxury colognes in a new trend known as ‘smellmaxxing’
headlines.description: For some teen boys’ back-to-school shopping, a new item has been added to the list: cologne. The social media trend known as ‘smellmaxxing’ has young boys layering different scents and spending hundreds of dollars on luxury bottles. NBC News’ Valerie Castro takes a look at the growing trend.

headlines.title: Judge orders Meta to pay hundreds of millions over kids’ mental health
headlines.description: Meta says it will appeal the order by a New Mexico judge that said the social media giant has to pay close to one billion dollars to address how its apps have contributed to harm to children. NBC News’ Brian Cheung reports.

headlines.title: Meta Ordered to Pay $567M in New Mexico Child Safety Case
headlines.description: A judge in New Mexico has ordered Meta, the parent company of Facebook and Instagram, to pay a massive $567 million penalty as part of a landmark trial. That amount is on top of the $375 million in damages imposed by a judge earlier this year who found Meta knowingly harmed children’s mental health on its platforms. NBC’s Brian Cheung reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Influencer Sydney Towle dies at 26 after documenting rare cancer illness
headlines.description: Sydney Towle, who shared her treatment for a rare form of cancer called Cholangiocarcinoma, has died. Towle used her social media to challenge assumptions about how people with serious illnesses live their lives. NBC News' Dana Griffin reports.

headlines.title: Miss North Carolina USA stripped of her crown after alleged past racist comments resurface
headlines.description: Miss North Carolina USA will no longer compete in Miss USA after organizers said she failed to uphold the pageant’s “standards and values,” raising questions about the future of beauty pageants in the U.S. NBC News’ Erin McLaughlin reports.

headlines.title: AI is looking for thousands of people to dig trenches for internet cables
headlines.description: The AI-powered growth of data centers is driving demand for human workers to lay new fiber optic cables from coast to coast.

headlines.title: U.S. bans many new foreign made robots
headlines.description: The FCC won’t allow many new foreign made robotic devices, a lot of them coming from China, to be sold in the U.S., citing national security and economic concerns. NBC News’ Brian Cheung reports.
